applies_why: The judge text awards DEFENDER WINS while also recording that the only CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN grade was retracted.
quote: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with "dates the finding" and "bounds the stated abstinence," so the witness was not left unanswered under the counting rule.
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count: (1) the standing is disregarded when its stated reason is retracted; (2) only the retracted reason is discounted while the standing label still counts.
why: Because the broken-collision grade and the standing's stated reason were expressly retracted, the DEFENDER WINS result lacks the condition the rule requires.
